title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Trust Records Retention
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal closes a mixed trust account and finalizes all client matters associated with it. According to LSO By-law 9, how long must the paralegal retain the trust accounting ledgers and journals?
questions.explain: Under LSO By-law 9, certain key financial records regarding trust accounts, including trust journals, client trust ledgers, and trust transfer records, must be retained for at least 10 full years immediately preceding the paralegal's most recent fiscal year end.
